map.内容宽 = max(各行显示宽度) + 2 × 左右边距；上下边框长度 = 内容: Content width = max(display width of each line) + 2 x side padding; top/bottom border length = content width; total lines = text lines + 2 x vertical padding + 2 (top and bottom borders)
map.显示宽度按\"视觉宽度\"计算：CJK 全角字符计 2 列、半角计 1 列，这是: Display width is computed as "visual width": CJK full-width characters count as 2 columns and half-width as 1, which is the key to drawing Chinese without skew; counting by code point would make Chinese-containing lines noticeably short. Side padding applies symmetrically to every line, so the content width follows the longest line and shorter lines are padded with spaces to match. Title mode centres "ToolBox" and occupies the middle of the border, truncating the decorative rule without changing the total width. Paste the copied result into a monospace environment (code editor, terminal); in a proportional font it will still misalign.

Entering "System Status" with the single-line style outputs:
┌───────────────┐
│ System Status │
└───────────────┘
It displays neatly centred in a monospace font, suitable for a log header or terminal welcome message.
map.框线依赖等宽字体（monospace）；中文在部分环境按 2 字符宽、英文 1: Box lines rely on a monospace font; in some environments Chinese is 2 characters wide and English 1, so use a renderer that supports CJK width or pad with spaces manually.
